name: Microsoft Security Response Center (MSRC) CVRF API v3
tier_rationale: Microsoft Corporation is an established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering; MSRC is the vendor's own security update channel (A8 trusted).

reliability.justification: Vendor-authoritative security update data for Microsoft products (KBs, fixed builds, affected products, Microsoft's own exploited / publicly disclosed flags).

msrc_patch_tuesday_cvrf.title: MSRC CVRF v3.0 /updates list and /cvrf/{yyyy-Mmm} month documents (Patch Tuesday: KBs, products, Exploited / Publicly Disclosed flags)
msrc_patch_tuesday_cvrf.notes: Quote: binding council text (P353 chair rationale); research C0762 terms 'Microsoft security update data (public)' (verified_live 200/405). GET only (HEAD answers 405); /updates ignores If-Modified-Since (200 + full body, Cache-Control no-store, verified 2026-11-26), so refreshes are driven by CurrentReleaseDate with cadence caps. Month documents are ~20 MB (2026-Nov: 20.7 MB) and are downloaded out of band only (never mid-scan), parsed one at a time and indexed into SQLite; Acknowledgments (researcher names) are never stored. 404 answers a bare JSON string 'Unable to find the specified file.'. Used by msrc_patch_tuesday (disclosure none at scan time).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G08-2 (P353). No published rate limit (no rate-limit headers observed 2026-11-26): one document at a time, >= 2 s apart.
